<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'echo "MRUBY_CONFIG=$MRUBY_CONFIG"; echo "CC=$CC"; echo "CFLAGS=$CFLAGS"; ls /gt/_work/src/build/host/ 2>/dev/null; cat /gt/_work/src/build/host/build_config.rb 2>/dev/null | head -20' 2>&1 | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
